notes.title: New Map! New Relic!, various changes and fixes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] New map "Space One": introduces building platforms for placement (to build in outer space!).
[*] New relic "Trusty Shovel": can dig corpses 1/wave (doesn't stack).
[*] New skill for Corpses "Prepare": *2 exp. for tomb/+1 level up for trees (per wave).
[*] Black Cat relic: increased crit. skill bonus from +2 to +3.
[*] Mirror relic: increased from +1 random tech. to +1 or +2 or +3 (random).
[*] Various fixes.
[/list]
